title: Proxy Availability
description: End-to-end probes through the HA proxy entries and every xray proxy (docs/00_Network_Proxy.md).

panels.title: ha-general · HTTP
panels.description: A request through ha-general's HTTP port returned 204 within 8 s. Unknown: no result in the last 90 s.

panels.title: ha-general · SOCKS5
panels.description: A request through ha-general's SOCKS5 port returned 204 within 8 s. Unknown: no result in the last 90 s.

panels.title: Pool proxies passing
panels.description: Proxies of the ha-general pool whose own SOCKS5 port passes the probe (the HA entry reaches them over SOCKS5), and the proxies configured. One passing proxy leaves no spare. Proxies are not necessarily independent failure domains.

targets.expr: count(((max by (entry) (probe_success{job="proxy-probe",kind="raw",pool="ha-general",protocol="socks"} unless on (instance) (time() - timestamp(probe_success{job="proxy-probe",kind="raw",pool="ha-general",protocol="socks"}) > 90))) or (max by (entry) (max_over_time(up{job="proxy-probe",kind="raw",pool="ha-general",protocol="socks"}[1d])) * 0 - 1)) == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Probe duration
panels.description: Time of the last probe through ha-general.

panels.title: Last check
panels.description: Age of the latest probe result. Older than 90 s: the status shows Unknown.

panels.title: Probe success rate 24h
panels.description: Share of the probes taken in the last 24 h that passed. Times without probes count neither way: see coverage.

panels.title: Coverage 24h
panels.description: Probes taken in the last 24 h, out of the 2880 a 30 s interval gives.

panels.title: ha-private · HTTP
panels.description: A request through ha-private's HTTP port returned 204 within 8 s. Unknown: no result in the last 90 s.

panels.title: ha-private · SOCKS5
panels.description: A request through ha-private's SOCKS5 port returned 204 within 8 s. Unknown: no result in the last 90 s.

panels.title: Proxies passing
panels.description: Proxies ha-private balances over, every public and private proxy, whose own SOCKS5 port passes the probe, and the proxies configured. Proxies are not necessarily independent failure domains.

targets.expr: count(((max by (entry) (probe_success{job="proxy-probe",kind="raw",pool=~"ha-general|ha-private",protocol="socks"} unless on (instance) (time() - timestamp(probe_success{job="proxy-probe",kind="raw",pool=~"ha-general|ha-private",protocol="socks"}) > 90))) or (max by (entry) (max_over_time(up{job="proxy-probe",kind="raw",pool=~"ha-general|ha-private",protocol="socks"}[1d])) * 0 - 1)) == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Probe duration
panels.description: Time of the last probe through ha-private.

panels.title: Last check
panels.description: Age of the latest probe result. Older than 90 s: the status shows Unknown.

panels.title: Probe success rate 24h
panels.description: Share of the probes taken in the last 24 h that passed. Times without probes count neither way: see coverage.

panels.title: Coverage 24h
panels.description: Probes taken in the last 24 h, out of the 2880 a 30 s interval gives.

panels.title: Proxies
panels.description: Each xray proxy, probed through its own ports and never through the HA entry. Pool: ha-general proxies carry the traffic of ha-general and ha-private; ha-private proxies only ha-private's; none: probed only. Access: Private means the proxy's own entry accepts only admin accounts. Xray API and traffic come from the proxy's exporter and do not show whether requests get through.

targets.expr: (max by (entry, pool, access) (probe_success{job="proxy-probe",kind="raw",protocol="http"} unless on (instance) (time() - timestamp(probe_success{job="proxy-probe",kind="raw",protocol="http"}) > 90))) or (max by (entry, pool, access) (max_over_time(up{job="proxy-probe",kind="raw",protocol="http"}[1d])) * 0 - 1)

panels.title: Probe results
panels.description: Passing, failing or unknown (no result for 90 s) per entry and protocol.

targets.expr: (max by (entry, protocol) (probe_success{job="proxy-probe"} unless on (instance) (time() - timestamp(probe_success{job="proxy-probe"}) > 90))) or (max by (entry, protocol) (max_over_time(up{job="proxy-probe"}[1d])) * 0 - 1)

panels.title: Probe results per 5 min (10 expected)
panels.description: Fewer than 10 means missing probe results: the exporter or Prometheus did not run.

panels.title: HA entry traffic by proxy
panels.description: Bytes per second the HA entry sends and receives through each proxy, ha-general and ha-private together, from xray-ha's own counters: client traffic on the proxy its connections use, plus Xray's own small probe fetches through every proxy.

panels.title: Probe success per hour
panels.description: The proxy portal's hourly status bars: each entry's probe success rate per hour, by protocol. The portal colours a bar by the worse protocol: green from 99 %, amber from 90 %, red below; grey when the coverage beside is under 50 %.

targets.expr: sum by (entry, protocol) (sum_over_time(probe_success{job="proxy-probe"}[1h])) / sum by (entry, protocol) (count_over_time(probe_success{job="proxy-probe"}[1h]))

panels.title: Probe coverage per hour
panels.description: The share of the 120 probes an hour expects that ran, per entry and protocol. Under 50 %, the portal's bar for that hour is grey.

panels.title: Probe success per day
panels.description: The proxy portal's daily status bars: each entry's probe success rate per 24 hours, by protocol, with the same colours as the hourly bars.

targets.expr: sum by (entry, protocol) (sum_over_time(probe_success{job="proxy-probe"}[24h])) / sum by (entry, protocol) (count_over_time(probe_success{job="proxy-probe"}[24h]))

panels.title: Probe coverage per day
panels.description: The share of the 2880 probes a day expects that ran, per entry and protocol. Under 50 %, the portal's bar for that day is grey.
